title: helm-executor observe: hook stdin envelope (v1)
description: The JSON a client hook writes to the stdin of `helm-executor observe`, passed through unchanged. Claude Code and Codex hook inputs both satisfy this schema. Unknown fields are allowed and ignored. `tool_input` and `tool_response` are read only to compute a digest and a short summary (the shape of a Bash command, the path of a file tool); they are never sent whole.

session_id.description: Client session id. Claude Code and Codex send it on every event.

hook_event_name.description: Optional. `--event` on the command line wins when both are present.

tool_name.description: Canonical tool name: Bash, Edit, Write, apply_patch, or mcp__<server>__<tool>.

tool_input.description: Tool arguments. Any JSON value; an object in practice.

tool_response.description: Tool result. Present on PostToolUse and PostToolUseFailure. Never sent.

cwd.description: Read for the Bash/file summaries only. Never sent on its own.

agent_id.description: Present only when the hook fires inside a subagent.

mcp_server.description: Claude Code 2.1.274 and later, MCP tools only.
